meta.description: Checks that an [OpenEoX](https://github.com/openeox) attestation describing the end of life or end of support of the artifact is available. The policy only looks for the attestation; policies that read specific support dates can build on it.
meta.name: OpenEoX Data Available

error.guidance: Capture the project End of Support in an OpenEOX file.

assessment.message: Found an OpenEoX statement with the artifact's EOS.
